summary: A break that exits a for...of loop must close the iterator.
caveats: A break targeting an inner construct but not exiting the for...of does not close this iterator.

tests.name: break runs generator finally
tests.input: function* g(){try{yield 1;yield 2}finally{console.log("close")}} for(const x of g()){break}

tests.name: full exhaustion does not force extra return
tests.input: let r=0; const it={i:0,next(){return this.i++?{done:true}:{value:1,done:false}},return(){r++;return {done:true}},[Symbol.iterator](){return this}}; for(const x of it){} console.log(r);
